research_venue.Name: Theodor-Heuss Platz Klappe
research_venue.Description: An older underground men's public toilet at Theodor-Heuss-Platz in Westend is the subject of two gay directories. May 2026 visitors describe encounters but one dated 17 May firsthand report alleges aggressive homophobic verbal abuse and a door kick while another man was present. July 2026 forum includes both a successful self-report and several separate unsuccessful visitors. This supports mixed recent real-world use and an important harassment warning, not a guarantee of crowds or fixed hours. Older posts refer to periodic closures and strong odours.
